question: Does the capacity to purify define the supreme guru?
premises: A person may be able to purify.
This purifying capacity is presented as decisive.
Such a person is considered the supreme guru.
inference: The ability to purify qualifies a person to be considered the supreme guru.
uncertainties: What is to be purified is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Whoever is able to purify is considered the supreme guru.
